div.head: Wl lad 2.3
div.ab: ⁊ gif se Englisca nele hine werian mid orneste oððe mid gewitnesse, he ladige hine mid irene.
Et si Anglicus nolit se defendere per bellum uel per testimonium, adlegiet se per Dei iudicium.
7 gif se Englisca nele hine werian mid orneste oððe mid gewitnesse, he ladige hine mid irene.
2, 3. Und wenn jener Englische [verklagt] sich weigert, durch Kampf oder durch Zeugenschaft [d. h. Eideshilfe] sich zu vertheidigen, reinige er sich durch Eisen[ordal].
2, 3. And if that Englishman [accused] refuses to defend himself by combat or by witnesses [i.e. oath-help], he shall clear himself by iron [ordeal].
And if the Englishman will not defend himself by combat or by compurgation, he shall clear himself by the ordeal of iron.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 232–233 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 484, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
